comparison.objective: Insert an emergency-stop body through a keyed panel hole and secure its rear locking ring.
comparison.physical_skill: Key/tab alignment, through-panel insertion, bimanual retention, and ring threading.
comparison.success_condition: Button flush and keyed; ring turned snug against panel; assembly released and stable.
comparison.reason: This is keyed insertion plus threaded fastening, with no impact, intentional fracture, or loose-part recovery.
